t.zh: 图像存进文件时，每个值只能取有限的几级：uint8 有 256 级。电路算出来的值还可能越出 [0, 1]。
t.en: When an image is stored, each value can take only a few levels: uint8 has 256. And values a circuit computes may leave [0, 1].

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一个值只能存成 L 级中的一级时，该存哪一级？L 级把 [0, 1] 等分，L = 3 时是 0、0.5、1。新元件<part-ref to="part:min"></part-ref>和<part-ref to="part:max"></part-ref>逐个值取两者中小的、大的。正好在两级中间时，约定取较大的一级。
t.en: This level asks: when a value can only be stored as one of L levels, which should it be? L levels divide [0, 1] evenly: with L = 3 they are 0, 0.5 and 1. The new parts <part-ref to="part:min"></part-ref> and <part-ref to="part:max"></part-ref> take the smaller and the larger of two, value by value. A value exactly between two levels goes to the larger, by convention.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和级数 L，输出量化后的图：先截到 [0, 1]，再存成最近的一级
desc.en: Takes an image and a number of levels L; gives the quantised image: clipped to [0, 1], then stored as the nearest level

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="quantisation"></wiki-ref>：uint8 就是 256 级的量化。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="quantisation"></wiki-ref>: uint8 is quantisation to 256 levels.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和级数 L：截到 [0, 1] 以后，每个值存成离它最近的一级。
brief.en: Given an image and a number of levels L, clip to [0, 1], then store each value as the level nearest to it.

hint.zh: 乘上 L − 1 以后，每一级正好落在一个整数上。
hint.en: Multiplied by L − 1, every level lands on a whole number.

hint.zh: −0.2 和 1.3 这样的值会算出不存在的级。
hint.en: Values such as −0.2 and 1.3 give levels that do not exist.
